profile.headline: Fraud and AML Compliance Technology
profile.summary:
●	Dynamic professional with over 12 years of experience in the IT industry including managing and leading Data delivery for Compliance, Enterprise Fraud, and Risk applications in the financial domain. 
●	Extensive experience with Business Intelligence tools including Microsoft BI Stacks, ETL concepts, Data warehouse development, cloud technologies, and other open-source ETL suites.
●	Well-rounded experience with Anti Money Laundering (BSA/AML) procedures and data delivery processes including OFAC Sanction screening, Customer Risk scoring, Transaction Monitoring, Alert management, and Adverse news
●	Involved in various Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures. Developed design, planning, and execution for data delivery for Compliance risk applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Perform a leading role during implementation projects for performing technical planning, and Data SME for Design and Architect Data delivery, deployments, and operationalization of the Compliance/Fraud solution.
●	Extensively working with Compliance Business SMEs, Senior compliance officers, BSA/AML officers, and the Financial investigating unit (FIU) for gathering requirements and actively cataloging and supporting various issues and providing their solutions.
●	Build data solutions for AML Products, such as International ACH (IAT) using NACHA, Complex wire data Parsing, OFAC feed for Sanction screening, diverse and customized customer risk scoring, Adverse media screening using RDC, and Suspicious Account Report (SAR) filing.
●	Working with the Compliance business analytics team to set up appropriate Data reconciliation reports using SSRS and tableau for various Data feeds such as Customer/Transaction reconciliation for effective AML monitoring. 
●	Engaged with the business team to resolve OCC and Internal audit data requests across the AML and fraud implementations, and help the team to set up tactical and strategic initiatives based on recommendations and MRAs. 
●	Support enterprise initiatives such as CCPA and GLBA implementation. Work with Risk and the third-party vendor to accurately assess application risk and define a business continuity plan.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Design ETL Pipeline for more than 30 different Source systems across the bank including retail and commercial clients for deposit, mortgage, and Loan lease products, with data delivery on a daily/Monthly.
●	Working with the Compliance business analytics team to set up appropriate Data reconciliation reports using SSRS and tableau for various Data feeds such as Customer/Transaction reconciliation for effective AML monitoring.

positions.title: Sr. ETL Developer
positions.description:
●	Worked with business users, and data architects to identify the business requirements and developed designed documents for ETL flow, and created various complex Transformations and Jobs.
●	Involved in building a Data warehouse whose primary source of data comes from external vendors and corporate sources which includes the data from various source systems like Oracle 10g, Flat files, and Microsoft Excel files, XML files.
●	Implemented Logic with a lookup table to maintain Parent-Child relationships and maintain the hierarchy

positions.title: Sr BI/Data Warehouse/ETL Developer
positions.description:
●	Actively involved in the analysis of database architecture of sources USPS site - known as (Movers Guide Online) MGO and MyMove.com, advertise Management tools from scratch.
●	Designed the Snowflake schema/Star schema STAGE, ARCHDATA, Centralized Data Warehouse (CDW), and Data Mart (DM) to accommodate the data from websites for web Traffic and Click Based Revenue domain. 
●	Created cubes, dimensions, and business-critical KPIs using SSAS representing aggregations in different ways - hierarchically and using custom groupings, that the company will use to analyze performance. Created MDX queries according to business requirements.

positions.title: Sr ETL Developer
positions.description:
●	Installed and Configured Oracle 10g on Windows Server 2008 according to requirements.
●	Designed Data mart and staging Database for the system using Star Schema which includes Tables, Stored Procedures, and Indexes.
●	Removed Duplicate records from the source using a complex query, analytical functions, and ad-hoc scripts.
●	Filtered data staging to EDW by using Complex SQL statements in Execute SQL Query Tasks and Transformations and implemented various Constraints and Triggers for data consistency and to preserve data integrity

positions.title: SSIS/SQL Server Developer
positions.description:
●	Installed and Configured Oracle 10g on Windows Server 2008 according to requirements.
●	Designed Data mart and staging Database for the system using Star Schema which includes Tables, Stored Procedures, and Indexes.
●	Removed Duplicate records from the source using a complex query, analytical functions, and ad-hoc scripts.
●	Filtered data staging to EDW by using Complex SQL statements in Execute SQL Query Tasks and Transformations and implemented various Constraints and Triggers for data consistency and to preserve data integrity
